questions.question: Which package manager / build tool should be used, and what exact command installs dependencies?
questions.truth: pnpm (packageManager pnpm@12.9.1; root preinstall runs `npx only-allow pnpm`). Install: `pnpm install` at the root.
reject: npm install / npm ci / yarn (blocked by only-allow pnpm)

questions.question: What exact command runs the full test suite?
questions.truth: `pnpm test` = test-unit + test-serve + test-build (CI builds first, then runs test-unit, test-serve, test-serve-bundled, test-build). E2E needs `pnpm build` and Playwright chromium.
accept: pnpm test / pnpm run test (optionally after pnpm build)
the explicit chain pnpm test-unit && pnpm test-serve && pnpm test-build

questions.question: What exact command runs only the tests in packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts?
questions.truth: Unit specs match `**/__tests__/**/*.spec.[tj]s` in the root vitest.config.ts; run from the repo root: `pnpm vitest run packages/vite/src/node/__tests__/config.spec.ts` or `pnpm test-unit <file>`.
accept: npx vitest run <file> from the repo root
reject: pnpm test <file> (the arg only reaches the last chained script, test-build; unit and serve still run everything)

questions.question: What exact command(s) check lint/formatting the way CI does?
questions.truth: CI lint job: `pnpm run lint` (eslint), `pnpm format && git diff --exit-code` (oxfmt formatting check), `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run test-docs`.
accept: pnpm run lint AND a format check (pnpm format then git diff --exit-code, or oxfmt --check); typecheck is an expected bonus

questions.question: Name files or directories in this repo that are generated or vendored and must not be edited by hand (or say none).
questions.truth: pnpm-lock.yaml (generated); build output dist/ (e.g. packages/vite/dist, gitignored); packages/vite/src/types/*.d.ts are inlined third-party type definitions copied from upstream (alias, chokidar, ws, connect); CHANGELOG.md files are generated at release (merge-changelog tooling).
accept: Score 1 if it names pnpm-lock.yaml plus at least one of: dist/ outputs, the vendored d.ts in packages/vite/src/types, generated CHANGELOG.md. Score 0.5 if it names only one item.
